description: We are Ares Twin Dynamics, tackling Interplanetary Survival Guide: Martian Map. Using Physical AI, Python (FastAPI), and NASA datasets (Mars Trek, Curiosity/Perseverance MMGIS & Raw Images, USGS Geology, Worldview), we built a working 3D Marswalk Digital Twin & Visor AR HUD modeling 0.38g O2 burn, wheel slip, and radiation shielding. Join us if you love planetary geology/GIS, 3D UI/UX, Python/ML, or 30s video storytelling—our live prototype is ready to level up together!
